confidence_notes: These are holistic estimates rather than live listing prices. Restaurant anchors are more stable; Copenhagen accommodation varies widely by property and exact November availability, and one-star inventory is especially limited. Cocktail and wine estimates use their usual premium over local draft beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Copenhagen's high-cost Nordic capital price level, with Stockholm and Oslo as broad comparables; midweek November lodging is estimated toward the lower end of its usual visitor range.
